parts.text:
Fig. 5.2 describes an agricultural project which has been introduced in part of China.
Millions of Chinese farmers have taken part in an agricultural project. The project has involved a large
investment in research and training. The aim has been to continue to produce enough food for China’s rising
population. Workshops and training gave advice on which crops to plant, when to plant and how much
fertiliser to use. The project has reduced the application of fertiliser by 1.2 million tons, reducing the amount
of fertiliser runoff which causes water pollution. This reduction in fertiliser used has saved 12.2 billion US
dollars.
